jobs.title: PATIENT CARE COORDINATOR WELLNESS CONSULTANT
jobs.description:
**Absolute Integrative Physical Medicine – Vacaville, CA**

***Please Read Before Applying***

* After submitting your resume and answering Indeed’s standard questions, check your Indeed Messages for a separate message from our clinic directly. Please reply to all three written questions. **Applications without these completed questions will not be reviewed.**
* Please do not call or visit the clinic as our staff is occupied with patient care. All hiring communication is handled through Indeed.

**About the Position**

We are looking for a warm, dependable, and encouraging Patient Care Consultant to care for patients participating in our red light therapy and wellness program.

This is a patient-facing position rather than a front desk or receptionist role. You will work directly with people who want to improve their health, lose weight, reduce inflammation, and feel better.

You will meet individually with prospective patients, listen to their concerns and goals, explain how the program works, answer their questions, help them determine whether it is a good fit, explain program costs, and help patients complete enrollment.

After patients begin the program, you will continue working closely with them: assisting with treatments, checking on their progress, providing encouragement, and helping them stay consistent.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building one-on-one relationships and finds it rewarding to help people make positive changes in their lives.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct individual wellness consultations
* Learn about each patient’s needs, concerns, and goals
* Explain the red light therapy program clearly and comfortably
* Answer questions and help patients make informed decisions
* Explain program options and costs and assist with enrollment
* Follow up with people who have expressed interest in the program
* Assist patients on and off the red light therapy equipment
* Monitor progress and provide encouragement and accountability
* Maintain accurate patient, consultation, and follow-up notes
* Help manage the program’s daily schedule and operations

**Who We Are Looking For**

The right person is:

* Warm, patient, and naturally easy to talk to
* A thoughtful listener who makes people feel comfortable and understood
* Confident communicating individually with many different personalities
* Comfortable explaining program costs and helping people make decisions
* Consistent with follow-up and attentive to details
* Organized, dependable, and receptive to coaching
* Genuinely interested in health, wellness, and helping others
* Motivated by seeing patients achieve meaningful results

Previous sales or enrollment experience is helpful but not required. We are also open to applicants with strong one-on-one experience in customer service, patient care, management of others, wellness, med spas, fitness, massage practices, membership programs, leasing, account management, or other relationship-based positions.

**Full-Time Schedule:** Monday–Thursday, 8:00 AM–7:00 PM

**Compensation:** $22–$26 per hour plus commissions and performance bonuses after the probationary period

**Benefits:** Health insurance, paid time off, and employee discounts

**About Us**

Absolute Integrative Physical Medicine helps people struggling with chronic pain, inflammation, weight, mobility, and other health concerns improve their health and quality of life through non-surgical wellness programs.

How to Apply

* Submit your résumé through Indeed.
* Check your Indeed Messages after applying.
* Reply to the three written questions sent by our clinic.

Please do not call or visit the clinic regarding this position.

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* This role requires working on-site in Vacaville, CA, Mon-Thurs from 8am to 7pm. Are you able to reliably commute to our office for this schedule?

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

Motive is seeking an accomplished customer success executive to serve as AVP, Customer Success — Enterprise & Strategic Accounts. This leader will own the strategy, operating rhythm, and performance of customer success for Motive’s largest and most complex customers in North America.

The AVP will lead a high-performing organization responsible for driving measurable customer outcomes, product adoption, retention, and expansion. This person will build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, create a predictable and data-driven customer success model, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, and Marketing.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role for an operator who can set direction, raise standards, simplify execution, and personally engage when the customer relationship or business outcome demands executive leadership.

* Set the vision and strategy for enterprise and strategic customer success, aligned to Motive’s company priorities and customers’ most important business outcomes.

* Own the operating model for customer health, executive sponsorship, success planning, risk management, renewals, and expansion in partnership with Sales and account leadership.

* Work cross-functionally with Support, Professional Services, Operations, and other teams to resolve systemic issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
* Develop scalable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, executive business reviews, risk mitigation, renewal management, and expansion.
* Personally lead high-impact customer escalations and strategic account interventions, bringing urgency, sound judgment, and a long-term perspective.
* Define and communicate the team’s goals, metrics, forecasts, and performance trends to executive leadership.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, remove friction, and increase the effectiveness of the customer success organization.

* 12+ years of experience in customer success, account management, professional services, or a related customer-facing function, including 5+ years leading senior customer success organizations.
* Experience leading customer success for enterprise and strategic accounts in a complex B2B technology, SaaS, platform, or hardware-enabled software environment.

### **Preferred experience:**

* Experience supporting customers with complex operational, logistics, transportation, field-service, or other physical-world workflows.

* Experience building or modernizing customer health scoring, renewal forecasting, executive sponsorship, or scaled success programs.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Integration (BO&I) US Operate Business Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
The US Operate Strategy & Execution team is a cross-business strategy function that helps shape and execute the growth agenda for BO&I US Operate, specifically supporting the build of new capabilities that further our LTP aspirations. We work alongside business, offering, industry, and enabling-function leaders to identify strategic opportunities, assess investment priorities, mobilize the capabilities and resources required to create and deliver new services, and facilitate execution of the particular investment.  
  
The initial focus for this role will be **Industry Innovation**: identifying where changing client needs, industry disruption, emerging technologies, and evolving delivery models create opportunities for US Operate to differentiate, grow, and scale. The role will help businesses and leaders move priority opportunities from insight and strategy through investment decisions, service creation, pilot activity, commercialization, and execution.  
  
Over time, the role may expand to additional US Operate strategy priorities, including growth strategy, portfolio development, sales growth, commercialization, operating-model evolution, strategic partnerships, and/or other cross-business initiatives.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on October 23, 2026  
  
**Work you'll do:**  
  
As a Business Strategy Manager - US Operate, you will lead selected strategic workstreams on behalf of the US Operate Strategy & Execution team. You will help business leaders make informed choices, align stakeholders, mobilize investments, and move new services from concept to execution.  
  
You will:  
  

* Lead cross-business strategy workstreams that address priority US Operate growth opportunities, including problem definition, market and industry assessment, strategic options, investment recommendations, execution planning, and outcome tracking.

  

* Facilitate business strategy development by bringing together leaders from relevant businesses, offerings, industries, and enabling functions to define opportunities, evaluate trade-offs, and establish shared priorities.

  

* Develop Industry Innovation perspectives by analyzing industry disruption, client needs, market signals, competitor activity, emerging technologies, and changes in service-delivery models.

  

* Identify opportunities for new services and capabilities and work with business leaders to assess their strategic relevance, market potential, differentiation, scalability, and organizational requirements.

  

* Co-develop service concepts with the businesses, helping translate market and client needs into viable service propositions, capability requirements, pilot approaches, and commercialization pathways.

  

* Build investment decision materials that clarify the opportunity, strategic rationale, expected value, required resources, risks, dependencies, and choices for leadership consideration.

  

* Help mobilize investments alongside the businesses by coordinating the people, funding, technology, leadership attention, and other resources needed to test, develop, and scale priority initiatives.

  

* Orchestrate incubation, piloting, and scaling activities across business and enabling teams, ensuring that decision gates, handoffs, dependencies, and ownership are clear.

  

* Partner with business leaders on go-to-market and commercialization planning, including target industries and clients, value propositions, market points of view, differentiated messaging, pursuit enablement, and scaling requirements.

  

* Facilitate executive governance and decision-making by preparing leadership meetings, framing decisions, surfacing trade-offs, documenting actions, and maintaining momentum across complex initiatives.

  

* Develop executive-ready strategy materials, including opportunity assessments, business cases, investment recommendations, portfolio views, strategic roadmaps, decision memos, operating-model implications, and leadership presentations.

  

* Connect related efforts across US Operate to identify opportunities for shared capabilities, reusable assets, cross-business collaboration, and more effective investments.

  

* Track strategic progress and outcomes by monitoring market signals, initiative milestones, adoption, business impact, risks, and lessons learned; recommend adjustments when needed.

  

* Partner with product, technology, and delivery teams when initiatives require digital platforms, AI-enabled solutions, analytics, or technology implementation, while maintaining the strategic, commercial, and organizational perspective.

  

* Lead and develop project teams and workstreams, providing structure in ambiguous environments, maintaining high standards for quality, and mentoring team members.

  
**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive-level presentations and storyboarding complex topics.

  

* Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills, especially with senior stakeholders.

  

* Strong proficiency in thoughtfully using AI to accelerate work development and in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  

* Enterprise and cross-business perspective, with the ability to see connections across businesses, offerings, industries, and enabling functions.

  

* Structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to frame ambiguous issues, develop hypotheses, evaluate options, and make clear recommendations.

  

* Strong facilitation and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to align senior stakeholders without direct authority.

  

* Ability to lead strategy and investment discussions that balance market opportunity, client value, differentiation, feasibility, required capabilities, and expected return.

jobs.title: Quality Manager Senior
jobs.description:
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

At Modine, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™. For more than 100 years, Modine has delivered innovative thermal management solutions that power critical industries worldwide. As demand for high-performance cooling solutions continues to accelerate, successful product development and launch execution are essential to ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term product reliabiliy.

The Senior Quality Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) is responsible for leading all quality planning and quality engineering activities associated with new product development and launch programs. This position serves as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for ensuring quality requirements, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed throughout Modine's stage-gate product development process.

The role provides independent assessment of product, process, supplier, and manufacturing readiness while ensuring quality considerations are appropriately represented during development reviews and launch decision-making. Through proactive risk identification, structured quality planning, and cross-functional collaboration, the Senior Quality Manager helps ensure products are launched on time, with robust manufacturing processes, capable suppliers, and exceptional customer quality performance

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**NPI Quality Leadership & Stage-Gate Governance**

* Serve as the primary quality representative for assigned New Product Introduction programs.
* Lead all quality planning and quality engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure completion of required quality activities and deliverables at each stage-gate milestone.
* Assess product, process, supplier, and customer quality risks and communicate readiness status during gate reviews.
* Provide independent quality recommendations regarding progression through development and launch phases.
* Drive accountability and closure of quality-related open items prior to launch approval.

**Design Quality & Risk Management**

* Participate as an embedded member of product development teams, representing the voice of quality throughout design and development activities.
* Facilitate Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Design Risk Reviews, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) development, and Design for Quality (DFQ) activities.
* Ensure historical quality lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance feedback are incorporated into product designs.
* Partner with Engineering to identify and mitigate design risks early in development.
* Support development and execution of Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) and validation strategies.

**Manufacturing Readiness & Process Quality**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Plant Quality teams to ensure production processes are capable and launch-ready.
* Lead or facilitate Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and process validation activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated into manufacturing processes, inspection plans, and production documentation.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and launch preparedness assessments.
* Coordinate quality activities associated with prototype, pilot, and production builds.

**Prototype, Pilot & Launch Support**

* Provide hands-on quality support during engineering builds, prototype builds, pilot builds, and production launch activities.
* Monitor build quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead investigation of build issues, nonconformances, and launch-related concerns.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated prior to production release.
* Support transition of products into normal production and operational ownership.

**Quality Metrics, Reporting & Readiness Reviews**

* Develop and maintain NPI quality scorecards and launch readiness metrics.
* Track quality risks, open issues, corrective actions, validation status, supplier readiness, and manufacturing readiness.
* Present quality status, recommendations, and risk assessments during program and leadership reviews.
* Provide clear visibility of launch risks and mitigation plans.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Program Management, or related technical disciplines.
* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting new product development, product launches, or quality planning activities.
* Strong knowledge of:
* DFMEA
* PFMEA
* APQP
* PPAP
* Control Plans
* Process Validation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Experience leading complex cross-functional projects and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Strong communication, facilitation, project manageme

jobs.title: Crypto Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Crypto Project Manager**

Salary: $200,000 – $300,000 per year

Job Type: Full-time | Remote / Hybrid

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Crypto Project Manager to lead the delivery of high-impact Web3 products — from token launches and exchange integrations to wallet infrastructure and DeFi protocols. This is not a coordination role. You will own the full project lifecycle, make critical trade-off decisions, and be directly accountable for shipping on time, on budget, and on spec.

You will work at the intersection of engineering, product, compliance, and external partners, turning complex blockchain requirements into clear execution plans. If you thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and want your work measured by real on-chain results — this role is for you.

**What You Will Actually Do**

Own end-to-end delivery of crypto projects: scoping, roadmap, sprint planning, release, and post-launch optimization.

Coordinate cross-functional teams — smart contract developers, backend engineers, QA, designers, legal/compliance, and marketing.

Manage external integrations: exchanges (CEX/DEX), custodians, payment providers, wallets, and blockchain networks.

Translate technical complexity into clear milestones, risks, and dependencies for stakeholders and leadership.

Drive token launches, listings, and migrations — including smart contract audits, liquidity planning, and go-to-market coordination.

Track and report on timelines, budgets, blockers, and KPIs using tools like Jira, Notion, Linear, and on-chain analytics.

Identify and mitigate risks specific to Web3: smart contract vulnerabilities, regulatory changes, network congestion, and market volatility.

Build and improve processes so the team ships faster without sacrificing security or compliance.

**What We Expect From You**

3–6+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 2 years in crypto, Web3, or fintech.

Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time — ideally involving blockchain, payments, or trading systems.

Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals: wallets, smart contracts, gas, Layer 1/Layer 2, DeFi, and tokenomics.

Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum, roadmap planning, and cross-team coordination.

Excellent English communication — you can align engineers, executives, and external partners in the same conversation.

Comfort with ambiguity: Web3 changes fast, and you make decisions with incomplete information.

Nice to have: PMP, PMI-ACP, or Certified Scrum Master; experience with Solidity, EVM chains, or on-chain data tools.

**Why This Role Pays $200k–$300k**

This is a senior, high-ownership position with direct impact on revenue, security, and product delivery. You are not managing tasks — you are managing outcomes that can make or break a product launch. The compensation reflects:

High responsibility: You own critical infrastructure and token-related projects with real financial exposure.

Scarce skill set: Few project managers combine traditional PM discipline with deep Web3 literacy.

Market demand: Crypto companies compete globally for managers who can ship under regulatory and technical pressure.

Performance impact: Your work directly affects trading volume, user growth, and partnership revenue.

**What We Offer**

$200,000 – $300,000 annual salary, based on experience and track record.

Remote-first with flexible hours and async-friendly culture.

Token/equity incentives for long-term alignment.

Learning budget for conferences, certifications, and on-chain tooling.

Direct access to leadership — no bureaucracy, fast decisions.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a short note describing one crypto project you delivered end-to-end — what it was, your role, the biggest obstacle, and the measurable result.

Pay: $200,900.00 - $300,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Panorays is a company dedicated to reducing supply chain cyber risk so companies worldwide can quickly and securely do business together. We provide a comprehensive third-party cybersecurity solution that creates a new business world where cybersecurity isn’t just a necessary business cost but an integral driver of growth. With Panorays, our customers’ defenses constantly evolve with their risk landscape, enabling companies to scale confidently with a solution that grows as they do.

**About the Role**

The ideal Technical Account Manager is an experienced, hands-on technical advisor who understands how security and risk teams build and run a third-party risk program. You have taken complex enterprise customers from signed contract to production, you bring depth in APIs, integrations, and security, and you have the credibility to act as the trusted technical partner to a CISO’s team. You have a bias for action: you dig into the detail, remove friction, and turn technical guidance into measurable adoption. Peers come to you with the hardest technical problems.

As a Technical Account Manager, you serve as the primary technical owner for a portfolio of Panorays enterprise accounts. In this role, you drive customer onboarding and deployment, execute long-term adoption strategies, and deliver regular health reviews. You closely collaborate across internal teams, including Account Management, Support, Sales Engineering, Product Management, R&D, and Security Research, to ensure seamless solution integration and customer success.

* Take the handoff from Sales on every new customer in your portfolio, and own onboarding end to end: welcome, kickoff, success criteria signed off, and deployment scope agreed.
* Run deployment as a project: project plan, weekly status, weekly working sessions, a risk and issue log, and a formal close-out signed off by the customer.
* Design how Panorays fits the customer’s third-party risk program, and document it in the customer’s architecture and operating blueprint: data flows, ownership, workflows across the supplier lifecycle, and the integration sequence.
* Advise customers on the maturity of their third-party risk program, and on the operating model, controls, and integrations that move it to the next level.
* Lead the technical implementation of APIs and integrations with the customer’s systems, such as GRC, procurement and ticketing platforms, SSO and data platforms; build and test the calls yourself before they reach the customer.
* Build each customer’s success plan with the Account Manager, with measurable goals tied to their security, risk, and compliance objectives, and project-manage adoption across the teams and business units that use Panorays.
* Run the adoption cadence with the Account Manager, including admin and end-user training, and drive licence utilization to target.
* Review each customer’s Panorays configuration on a regular cadence, including supplier tiering, questionnaires, monitoring and workflows, and recommend changes that strengthen their program and adopt new capabilities as they ship.
* Serve as the primary technical contact for your accounts by resolving complex technical escalations, documenting defects, capturing feature requests and adoption blockers, and collaborating with R&D and Product Management to prioritize fixes and workarounds.
* Build trusted relationships with CISOs, risk leaders, architects, and engineers, and be the customer’s recognized expert on how Panorays fits their environment.
* Spot technical expansion signals, such as new use cases, modules, and integrations, and document technical renewal risks; bring both to the Account Manager.
* Create best-practice guides, architecture patterns, and enablement content for customers and for the CS team; keep Planhat current and contribute to the playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge base the team works from.

**Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles for B2B SaaS, preferably cybersecurity or risk management, with at least 3 years as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions or Customer Success Engineer, Implementation Consultant, or Sales Engineer.
* BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline, or relevant professional experience.
* Track record of taking complex enterprise customers from signed contract to production, including multi-system integrations.
* Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs using appropriate tools (cURL, Postman, or similar), including authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0 / bearer tokens), JSON payloads, and webhooks - a must.
* Experience integrating SaaS platforms with enterprise systems such as GRC (ServiceNow, Archer), SSO (SAML, OIDC), and data platforms.
* Experience running enterprise deployments as projects: plans, status reporting, risks and issues, stakeholders, and close-out.
* Experience building executive-level relationships with CISOs and risk leaders, and owning the technical relationship across a portfolio of enterprise accounts.
* Experience using health and usage data to influence adoption and retention across a portfolio.
* High level of verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to set expectations, present to executives, and work in detail with engineers - a must.
* Ability to run several customer projects at once, and to build processes, templates, and playbooks where none exist yet.
* Willingness to work [U.S. / EMEA] business hours, and to travel 50% - a must.

**Bonus / Preferred**

* **﻿**Experience in third-party risk management (TPRM), GRC, or vendor risk assessment.
* Strong technical understanding of web security and networking: DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/S, common web vulnerabilities, and attack surface.
* Working knowledge of security and regulatory frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DORA, and NIS2, and how they shape a customer’s third-party risk program.

jobs.title: Content & E-commerce Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Content & E-commerce Operations Manager — Remote

We are looking for a creative, proactive **Content & E-commerce Operations Manager** to join a growing dental e-commerce business.

This role will **start part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week**, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position as responsibilities grow.

The main focus: Content creation

The most important part of this role is the ability to **take an idea and execute it into finished content**.

I may send you:

* A TikTok, Instagram Reel, or ad that is trending
* A competitor/reference video that I like
* Raw footage that I recorded
* Product photos or videos
* A rough concept, hook, or script

Your job will be to understand what makes the reference work and then use our own footage and products to create a **new, polished piece of content** inspired by the concept.

You should be able to take the project from:

**Reference/idea → raw footage → editing → captions/effects → finished video → revisions → ready to post**

I do not want someone who needs detailed instructions for every edit. I am looking for someone who can understand the direction, use good creative judgment, show me a finished version, receive feedback, and quickly improve it.

Content responsibilities

You may be responsible for:

* Editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and Meta ads
* Turning raw footage into polished short-form videos
* Recreating the concept/style of trending content using our own original footage
* Finding relevant trends and creative ideas
* Creating strong hooks and improving video pacing
* Adding subtitles, text, graphics, transitions and sound
* Creating multiple variations of successful videos and ads
* Editing product demonstration videos
* Creating social media posts and graphics
* Repurposing one piece of footage into several different pieces of content
* Helping build a consistent content calendar
* Making revisions based on feedback
* Using AI to speed up and improve content production

Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield**, or similar AI image/video/content tools is highly preferred.

You do not need to already know every AI platform. What matters more is that you are comfortable learning new tools quickly and using technology creatively.

E-commerce & operations

As the role develops, you will also help manage the day-to-day operations of our Shopify store.

Responsibilities may include:

* Shopify product updates
* Uploading products, photos and videos
* Updating variants, pricing and product information
* Basic product-page improvements
* Monitoring orders
* Handling tracking and shipping issues
* Customer-service emails
* Returns and replacements
* Coordinating order issues with suppliers/fulfillment partners
* Klaviyo/email-marketing support
* Scheduling social media content
* Basic reporting
* Organizing files and content
* Creating and improving SOPs
* Identifying problems and helping solve them without waiting to be asked

You do **not** need to be a Shopify developer. Basic Shopify/e-commerce experience is helpful, but **strong content-creation ability is more important for this position**.

Who we are looking for

We want someone who is:

* Creative and has a strong eye for short-form content
* Comfortable editing video independently
* Very familiar with Instagram, TikTok and social-media trends
* Comfortable experimenting with AI tools
* Proactive and able to solve problems
* Organized and reliable
* Able to work independently
* Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions quickly
* Interested in learning how the entire e-commerce business operates
* Interested in growing into a larger role over time

Requirements

* Strong written and spoken English
* Proven short-form video-editing experience
* Examples of previous Reels, TikToks, ads or other social content
* Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar editing software
* Comfortable with Canva
* Comfortable using AI tools
* Reliable internet connection
* Availability overlapping with **U.S. Central Time**
* Shopify/e-commerce experience is preferred but not required

**Mexico is preferred** because of the time-zone overlap, but we are open to excellent candidates elsewhere in Latin America.

Schedule

**Part-time to start: approximately 15–20 hours per week.**

The goal is to gradually increase responsibilities and potentially transition the right person into a **full-time position**.

Long-term opportunity

This is not intended to be only a video-editing position.

For the right person, the goal is to gradually become a key **day-to-day operator of the business**, taking ownership of content production and recurring e-commerce operations.

The founder will increasingly focus on strategy, new products, recording content and growing the business, while you help execute and manage the daily workflow.

How to apply

Please include:

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile.
* **3–5 examples of short-form videos, Reels, TikToks or ads that you personally edited.**
* Which editing and AI tools you currently use.
* Any Shopify or e-commerce experience you have.
* Your current availability.
* Your expected hourly rate.
* A short answer to this question:

**If I send you a trending Instagram Reel and several raw video clips of my own, briefly explain how you would turn them into a new video for our brand.**

**Important:** Applications without examples of previous video/content work may not be considered.

Pay: $10.00 - $15.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

At Modine, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™. For more than 100 years, Modine has delivered innovative thermal management solutions that power critical industries worldwide. As demand for high-performance cooling solutions continues to accelerate, successful product development and launch execution are essential to ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term product reliabiliy.

The Senior Quality Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) is responsible for leading all quality planning and quality engineering activities associated with new product development and launch programs. This position serves as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for ensuring quality requirements, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed throughout Modine's stage-gate product development process.

The role provides independent assessment of product, process, supplier, and manufacturing readiness while ensuring quality considerations are appropriately represented during development reviews and launch decision-making. Through proactive risk identification, structured quality planning, and cross-functional collaboration, the Senior Quality Manager helps ensure products are launched on time, with robust manufacturing processes, capable suppliers, and exceptional customer quality performance

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**NPI Quality Leadership & Stage-Gate Governance**

* Serve as the primary quality representative for assigned New Product Introduction programs.
* Lead all quality planning and quality engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure completion of required quality activities and deliverables at each stage-gate milestone.
* Assess product, process, supplier, and customer quality risks and communicate readiness status during gate reviews.
* Provide independent quality recommendations regarding progression through development and launch phases.
* Drive accountability and closure of quality-related open items prior to launch approval.

**Design Quality & Risk Management**

* Participate as an embedded member of product development teams, representing the voice of quality throughout design and development activities.
* Facilitate Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Design Risk Reviews, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) development, and Design for Quality (DFQ) activities.
* Ensure historical quality lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance feedback are incorporated into product designs.
* Partner with Engineering to identify and mitigate design risks early in development.
* Support development and execution of Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) and validation strategies.

**Manufacturing Readiness & Process Quality**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Plant Quality teams to ensure production processes are capable and launch-ready.
* Lead or facilitate Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and process validation activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated into manufacturing processes, inspection plans, and production documentation.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and launch preparedness assessments.
* Coordinate quality activities associated with prototype, pilot, and production builds.

**Prototype, Pilot & Launch Support**

* Provide hands-on quality support during engineering builds, prototype builds, pilot builds, and production launch activities.
* Monitor build quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead investigation of build issues, nonconformances, and launch-related concerns.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated prior to production release.
* Support transition of products into normal production and operational ownership.

**Quality Metrics, Reporting & Readiness Reviews**

* Develop and maintain NPI quality scorecards and launch readiness metrics.
* Track quality risks, open issues, corrective actions, validation status, supplier readiness, and manufacturing readiness.
* Present quality status, recommendations, and risk assessments during program and leadership reviews.
* Provide clear visibility of launch risks and mitigation plans.

---------------------------------------

At **PRI**, we're seeking motivated, people-oriented individuals who want to build a career in financial services while helping individuals and families work toward greater financial confidence and long-term security.

Whether you're exploring a new career path, looking to expand your professional skills, or interested in developing a business of your own, this opportunity offers the potential to grow with the right training, mentorship, and commitment.

**Responsibilities**

* As you progress through training and complete the applicable licensing requirements, you’ll have the opportunity to:
* **Connect with Individuals and Families:** Meet with clients, primarily through virtual appointments, to understand their needs and goals.
* **Understand Financial Priorities:** Learn about clients’ financial objectives, concerns, and long-term aspirations.
* **Promote Financial Education:** Help individuals and families build financial knowledge and understand strategies that may support their goals.
* **Provide Financial Solutions:** Assist eligible clients with financial products and services for which you are appropriately licensed and authorized.
* **Build Meaningful Relationships:** Develop and maintain professional relationships based on communication, trust, and ongoing service.
* **Stay Connected:** Follow up with prospective and existing clients to provide continued support and address evolving needs.
* **Grow Your Business:** Build your client base through networking, prospecting, and referrals.
* **Invest in Your Development:** Participate in training sessions, team meetings, mentorship, and ongoing professional development.
* **Maintain Professional Standards:** Follow company policies, established procedures, and all applicable regulatory requirements.

**Qualifications**

* We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to learn, build meaningful relationships, and grow professionally. Ideal candidates will:
* Be at least 18 years of age.
* Be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Meet applicable background screening and licensing requirements.
* Demonstrate strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Enjoy connecting with individuals and families and understanding their needs.
* Have reliable internet access and be comfortable participating in virtual meetings.
* Be committed to completing required training and obtaining applicable licenses.
* Be self-motivated, dependable, and comfortable working in a goal-oriented, performance-based environment.

Join us as a District Operations Manager to lead transformative change across our districts! Bring your passion for strategic management, operational excellence, and team leadership to make a lasting impact on our organization’s success while advancing your career in a vibrant environment dedicated to growth and innovation.

Pay: $1,000.00 - $3,500.00 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement

new_jobs.title: Content & E-commerce Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Content & E-commerce Operations Manager — Remote

We are looking for a creative, proactive **Content & E-commerce Operations Manager** to join a growing dental e-commerce business.

This role will **start part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week**, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position as responsibilities grow.

The main focus: Content creation

The most important part of this role is the ability to **take an idea and execute it into finished content**.

I may send you:

* A TikTok, Instagram Reel, or ad that is trending
* A competitor/reference video that I like
* Raw footage that I recorded
* Product photos or videos
* A rough concept, hook, or script

Your job will be to understand what makes the reference work and then use our own footage and products to create a **new, polished piece of content** inspired by the concept.

You should be able to take the project from:

**Reference/idea → raw footage → editing → captions/effects → finished video → revisions → ready to post**

I do not want someone who needs detailed instructions for every edit. I am looking for someone who can understand the direction, use good creative judgment, show me a finished version, receive feedback, and quickly improve it.

Content responsibilities

You may be responsible for:

* Editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and Meta ads
* Turning raw footage into polished short-form videos
* Recreating the concept/style of trending content using our own original footage
* Finding relevant trends and creative ideas
* Creating strong hooks and improving video pacing
* Adding subtitles, text, graphics, transitions and sound
* Creating multiple variations of successful videos and ads
* Editing product demonstration videos
* Creating social media posts and graphics
* Repurposing one piece of footage into several different pieces of content
* Helping build a consistent content calendar
* Making revisions based on feedback
* Using AI to speed up and improve content production

Experience with tools such as **CapCut, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield**, or similar AI image/video/content tools is highly preferred.

You do not need to already know every AI platform. What matters more is that you are comfortable learning new tools quickly and using technology creatively.

E-commerce & operations

As the role develops, you will also help manage the day-to-day operations of our Shopify store.

Responsibilities may include:

* Shopify product updates
* Uploading products, photos and videos
* Updating variants, pricing and product information
* Basic product-page improvements
* Monitoring orders
* Handling tracking and shipping issues
* Customer-service emails
* Returns and replacements
* Coordinating order issues with suppliers/fulfillment partners
* Klaviyo/email-marketing support
* Scheduling social media content
* Basic reporting
* Organizing files and content
* Creating and improving SOPs
* Identifying problems and helping solve them without waiting to be asked

You do **not** need to be a Shopify developer. Basic Shopify/e-commerce experience is helpful, but **strong content-creation ability is more important for this position**.

Who we are looking for

We want someone who is:

* Creative and has a strong eye for short-form content
* Comfortable editing video independently
* Very familiar with Instagram, TikTok and social-media trends
* Comfortable experimenting with AI tools
* Proactive and able to solve problems
* Organized and reliable
* Able to work independently
* Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions quickly
* Interested in learning how the entire e-commerce business operates
* Interested in growing into a larger role over time

Requirements

* Strong written and spoken English
* Proven short-form video-editing experience
* Examples of previous Reels, TikToks, ads or other social content
* Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar editing software
* Comfortable with Canva
* Comfortable using AI tools
* Reliable internet connection
* Availability overlapping with **U.S. Central Time**
* Shopify/e-commerce experience is preferred but not required

**Mexico is preferred** because of the time-zone overlap, but we are open to excellent candidates elsewhere in Latin America.

Schedule

**Part-time to start: approximately 15–20 hours per week.**

The goal is to gradually increase responsibilities and potentially transition the right person into a **full-time position**.

Long-term opportunity

This is not intended to be only a video-editing position.

For the right person, the goal is to gradually become a key **day-to-day operator of the business**, taking ownership of content production and recurring e-commerce operations.

The founder will increasingly focus on strategy, new products, recording content and growing the business, while you help execute and manage the daily workflow.

How to apply

Please include:

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile.
* **3–5 examples of short-form videos, Reels, TikToks or ads that you personally edited.**
* Which editing and AI tools you currently use.
* Any Shopify or e-commerce experience you have.
* Your current availability.
* Your expected hourly rate.
* A short answer to this question:

**If I send you a trending Instagram Reel and several raw video clips of my own, briefly explain how you would turn them into a new video for our brand.**

**Important:** Applications without examples of previous video/content work may not be considered.

Pay: $10.00 - $15.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
